arxiv-2008-07933.title: Experiment-friendly formulation of quantum backflow
arxiv-2008-07933.creator: Marek Miller, Woo Chee Yuan, Rainer Dumke, Tomasz Paterek
arxiv-2008-07933.description: Abstract Quantum backflow is usually understood as a quantum interference phenomenon where probability current of a quantum particle points in the opposite direction to particle’s momentum. Here, we quantify the amount of quantum backflow for arbitrary momentum distributions, paving the way towards its experimental verification.

arxiv-2104-05233.title: An Evolutionary Approach to Adapt Tests Across Mobile Apps
arxiv-2104-05233.creator: Leonardo Mariani 1 , Mauro Pezzè 2 3 , Valerio Terragni 2 and Daniele Zuddas 2
arxiv-2104-05233.description: Abstract Automatic generators of GUI tests often fail to generate semantically relevant test cases, and thus miss important test scenarios. To address this issue, test adaptation techniques can be used to automatically generate semantically meaningful GUI tests from test cases of applications with similar functionalities.

arxiv-2111-15270.title: The Boltzmann-Grad Limit for the Lorentz Gas with a Poisson Distribution of Obstacles

arxiv-2111-15270.description: Abstract . In this note, we propose a slightly different proof of Gallavotti’s theorem [“Statistical Mechanics: A Short Treatise”, Springer, 1999, pp. 48–55] on the derivation of the linear Boltzmann equation for the Lorentz gas with a Poisson distribution of obstacles in the Boltzmann-Grad limit. In memory of Prof. Robert T. Glassey (1946-2020) 1.

arxiv-2208-03698.title: Molecular states of 𝑫 ∗ ​ 𝑫 ∗ ​ 𝑲 ¯ ∗ D^{*}D^{*}\bar{K}^{*} nature

arxiv-2208-03698.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by N. Ikeno, M. Bayar, E. Oset. We study the interaction of two D ∗ D^{*} and a K ¯ ∗ \bar{K}^{*} by using the Fixed Center Approximation to the Faddeev equations to search for bound states of the three body system.

arxiv-2405-20539.title: SleeperNets: Universal Backdoor Poisoning Attacks Against Reinforcement Learning Agents
arxiv-2405-20539.creator: Ethan Rathbun, Christopher Amato, Alina Oprea
arxiv-2405-20539.description: Abstract Reinforcement learning (RL) is an actively growing field that is seeing increased usage in real-world, safety-critical applications – making it paramount to ensure the robustness of RL algorithms against adversarial attacks. In this work we explore a particularly stealthy form of training-time attacks against RL – backdoor poisoning.

arxiv-2411-15918.title: Mechanical stability conditions for 3D and 2D crystals under arbitrary load
arxiv-2411-15918.creator: Marcin Maździarz
arxiv-2411-15918.description: Abstract The paper gathers and unifies mechanical stability conditions for all symmetry classes of 3D and 2D materials under arbitrary load. The methodology is based on the spectral decomposition of the fourth-order stiffness tensors mapped to second-order tensors using orthonormal (Mandel) notation, and the verification of the positivity of the so-called Kelvin moduli.

arxiv-2506-22706.title: General Autonomous Cybersecurity Defense: Learning Robust Policies for Dynamic Topologies and Diverse Attackers
arxiv-2506-22706.creator: Arun Ramamurthy, Neil Dhir
arxiv-2506-22706.description: Abstract In the face of evolving cyber threats such as malware, ransomware and phishing, autonomous cybersecurity defense ( acd ) systems have become essential for real-time threat detection and response with optional human intervention. However, existing acd systems rely on limiting assumptions, particularly the stationarity of the underlying network dynamics.

arxiv-2511-01150.title: Parastatistics revealed: Peierls phase twists and shifted conformal towers in interacting periodic chains
arxiv-2511-01150.creator: Dirk Schuricht, Jesko Sirker
arxiv-2511-01150.description: Abstract We consider interacting paraparticle chains with a constant R R -matrix where the Hamiltonian sums over the internal degrees (flavors) of the paraparticles. For such flavor-blind Hamiltonians we show a general factorization of the Hilbert space into occupation and flavor parts with the Hamiltonian acting non-trivially only on the former.

pmc-13583612.creator: Iris Menu, Lanxin Ji, Bosi Chen, Tanya Bhatia, Mark Duffy, Sofia Trapaga, Suzanne M Jacques, Faisal Qureshi, Adam Eggebrecht, Muriah D Wheelock, Christopher J Trentacosta, Moriah E Thomason

pmc-13611500.title: A Circulating Proteomic Signature of Allostatic Load Is Associated with Multisystem Disease and Mortality
pmc-13611500.creator: Yufan Guan, Jie Shen, Li Li, Kai Zhang, Song Liu, Qianqian Zhu, Philip I. Chow, Hongmei Jiang, Jing Li, Lifang Hou, Hua Zhao
pmc-13611500.description: Background: Chronic stress contributes to the development of cardiometabolic, malignant, and other chronic diseases through cumulative multisystem physiological dysregulation, conceptualized as allostatic load (AL). However, traditional AL relies on heterogeneous clinical biomarkers that are frequently unavailable or inconsistently collected in large cohorts, limiting reproducibility and translational utility.
